name: firecrawl
description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and access 550+ data providers through one API.
one_liner: A single API that turns any website into clean, structured data an AI agent can read — scraping, search, and crawling, so developers don't have to fight HTML and anti-bot walls themselves.
buyer: An AI startup founder building a product that needs live web data (prices, listings, news) but doesn't want to build and maintain a scraping team.
business_use_cases: A price-intelligence startup builds a 'track my competitors' prices' SaaS for small e-commerce brands entirely on top of Firecrawl's API.
A market-research agency offers clients an 'ask anything about any industry's web presence' service, feeding Firecrawl's output into an LLM.
A lead-gen agency scrapes company websites at scale to pre-qualify prospects before a sales call.

money_ideas.idea: Build a narrow vertical SaaS (e.g. restaurant menu price tracking) on top of the API and charge a monthly fee.
Resell scraped, cleaned datasets for a specific niche industry.

steal_this: Build a one-page 'watch this website, email me when the price changes' tool this weekend using Firecrawl as the scraping backend, and charge a few dollars a month per watched URL.
